impact_levels.low: Localized, readily reversible change with limited user or operational impact.
impact_levels.moderate: Change can affect a feature or service but has ordinary review and rollback paths.
impact_levels.high: Change can affect important production behavior, security, stored data, or service availability.
impact_levels.critical: Change can cause broad compromise, unrecoverable loss, or an irreversible production incident.

questions.label: Destructive or major infrastructure change
questions.instructions: Does this infrastructure patch delete resources or data, remove routes, or substantially refactor production infrastructure?

criteria.true: It destroys or replaces stateful resources, removes routing or availability paths, changes foundational topology, or performs a large coordinated infrastructure refactor.
criteria.false: It is a small additive adjustment, routine patch or version update, bounded configuration tuning, or another readily reversible infrastructure change.

questions.label: Extensive existing-feature change
questions.instructions: Does this application patch extensively change existing user-visible or business functionality rather than make a small additive or localized change?

criteria.true: It rewrites or broadly alters established behavior, shared flows, core business rules, or several existing feature paths.
criteria.false: It is mostly additive, localized, mechanical, test-only, or leaves established feature behavior substantially intact.

questions.label: Route or established feature removal
questions.instructions: Does this patch remove or disable an established application feature, API route, network route, ingress path, or service endpoint?

criteria.true: An existing supported behavior or traffic path is removed, disabled, made unreachable, or replaced without a compatible transition.
criteria.false: No established route or feature is removed, or the change only adds behavior or preserves a compatible transition.

questions.label: Risky dependency or platform upgrade
questions.instructions: Is this version, dependency, runtime, provider, or platform change likely to be breaking or operationally risky?

criteria.true: It is a major-version jump, changes compatibility or runtime behavior, has a broad dependency surface, or needs coordinated rollout and rollback.
criteria.false: It is a routine patch or minor update with bounded compatibility impact and an ordinary rollback path.

questions.label: Authentication or authorization boundary change
questions.instructions: Does this patch change or weaken an authentication or authorization boundary?

criteria.true: It changes identity verification, session handling, access checks, roles, permissions, tenancy isolation, or enforcement of who may perform an action.
criteria.false: It does not affect identity or access-control behavior, or it only changes presentation without changing enforcement.

questions.label: Data loss or corruption risk
questions.instructions: Could this patch plausibly delete, overwrite, mis-associate, or corrupt persisted user or production data?

criteria.true: A reachable path can lose, overwrite, truncate, duplicate, mis-map, or silently corrupt stored data.
criteria.false: Persisted data is not changed, or updates are narrowly validated and preserve existing data integrity.

questions.label: Irreversible migration
questions.instructions: Does this patch contain a database or storage migration that is destructive or difficult to reverse safely?

criteria.true: It drops or rewrites data, narrows a type, removes a column/table, or requires coordinated ordering without a safe backward-compatible rollback.
criteria.false: There is no migration, or the migration is additive, backward compatible, and has a credible safe rollback.

questions.label: Sensitive-data exposure
questions.instructions: Could this patch expose sensitive data to logs, clients, unauthorized users, third parties, or broader storage scopes?

criteria.true: PII, credentials, payment data, tokens, private tenant data, or other sensitive values can cross an inappropriate trust boundary.
criteria.false: No sensitive data flow changes, or access, redaction, transport, and storage controls remain appropriately scoped.

questions.label: Testing insufficient for impact
questions.instructions: Considering this patch and the supplied PR-level test facts, is the demonstrated testing insufficient for the likely impact?

criteria.true: Important changed behavior, edge cases, failure modes, migration paths, or security controls lack proportionate automated tests or stated validation.
criteria.false: The change is low impact or the included tests and validation are proportionate to its plausible failure modes.

questions.label: Rollback difficulty
questions.instructions: Would rolling back this change after deployment be difficult, unsafe, or unable to restore the prior state?

criteria.true: Rollback needs data repair, coordinated clients/services, manual intervention, long recovery, or cannot undo external or persisted effects.
criteria.false: The change can be reverted or disabled through an ordinary deploy or feature-control path without lasting side effects.

questions.label: Secrets or credentials risk
questions.instructions: Does this patch add, reveal, mishandle, or dangerously broaden access to secrets or credentials?

criteria.true: It includes secret material, logs or returns credentials, weakens secret storage, or broadens credential scope or lifetime unsafely.
criteria.false: No secret material or credential-handling behavior changes, or the patch uses established secure indirection and least privilege.

questions.label: Operational risk
questions.instructions: Could this patch materially harm production availability, capacity, latency, deployability, or observability?

criteria.true: A plausible path causes outage, overload, retry storms, unsafe deployment, missing visibility, or a hard-to-diagnose production failure.
criteria.false: Operational behavior is unchanged or the change has bounded failure modes, adequate safeguards, and useful visibility.

questions.label: Specialist security review needed
questions.instructions: Does this patch warrant review by a security specialist before merge?

criteria.true: It changes a trust boundary, cryptography, authentication, authorization, input-to-execution path, sensitive-data flow, or another security-critical control.
criteria.false: It has no meaningful security boundary impact and ordinary code review is sufficient.

questions.label: Explicit human approval needed
questions.instructions: Should this change require explicit human approval from an accountable owner before merge or deployment?

criteria.true: The change has high blast radius, destructive or irreversible effects, material compliance/security implications, or requires a coordinated operational decision.
criteria.false: Normal peer review is proportionate and the change is reversible with bounded impact.
